article.title: PayPal Deal Talks End as Advent, Stripe Group Abandons Acquisition Effort
article.summary: A consortium of buyout firm Advent and payment processor Stripe has decided to abandon its pursuit of fintech pioneer PayPal Holdings Inc., a potential deal that would have ranked as one of the biggest-ever leveraged buyouts, according to people familiar with the matter.

article.title: 身分驗證業者Socure募資1.56億美元，併購AI代理平臺Fravity
article.summary: 數位身分驗證與詐欺防治業者Socure併購AI代理平臺Fravity，並完成新一輪募資，公司估值提高至52億美元。路透社披露，本輪募資金額為1.56億美元。

article.title: Anthropic推出模型硬體標準，讓AI代理直接操作實驗室與製造設備
article.summary: Anthropic周四（8/27）宣布推出模型硬體標準（Model Hardware Standard，MHS）研究預覽版，讓AI代理人可直接操作顯微鏡、機械手臂、液體處理儀器等實體設備，應用範圍涵蓋科學研究與先進製造業，為Anthropic首度跨足硬體整合領域。

article.title: Google Photos could soon let you take a shortcut straight to your favorite media
article.summary: TL;DR Google Photos version 7.90 includes an unreleased feature that could let you pin custom shortcuts to the Collections tab. In testing, long-pressing folders, albums, or people allowed pinning them to a horizontal scrolling bar at the top of the app. A dedicated Edit menu could let you reorder pinned items or browse organized library categories to customize your view. When Google replaced the classic Library view with the updated Collections tab, it promised a cleaner way to organize media. However, the top of the screen has remained largely rigid, with Google automatically and unilaterally deciding which shortcuts to highlight while burying your most-used folders. article.title: Google Search's AI Mode can now track flight prices and book hotels for you
article.summary: Today Google is giving its AI Mode the ability to track flight prices for you. This is basically the existing Google Flights feature, but brought into AI Mode in Google Search. You can set up price alerts as you chat. You can also just use AI Mode like Google Flights now, simply describing where and when you want to fly and it will show you the best options available from over 300 partner airlines and travel sites. article.title: OpenAI提出網路集體防禦行動，獲Google、Anthropic及微軟等上百家企業呼應
article.summary: 有鑑於擔心隨著AI驅動的網路攻擊行動變得更成熟、普遍與複雜，OpenAI週四（8/27）發表一封公開信，呼籲全球應集體加強網路防禦，並且已獲得上百家企業連署，包括Google、Anthropic、微軟、AWS、AMD、Arm、思科、Dell、IBM、甲骨文（Oracle）、紅帽（Red Hat）、Uber、Sophos及Check Point等。
